gloss: receipts and disbursements; accounting of money

definitions.gloss: receipts and payments; cash accounting; bookkeeping of money
definitions.explanation: The taking in and paying out of money, and the keeping of records of those transactions. Used mainly in accounting and administrative contexts.

examples.japanese: {現金|げんきん}の{出納|すいとう}を{記録|きろく}する。
examples.english: To record cash receipts and payments.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{出納帳|すいとうちょう}をつけている。
examples.english: I keep a cashbook every day.

examples.japanese: {経理|けいり}{担当者|たんとうしゃ}が{毎月|まいつき}{出納|すいとう}を{締|し}めて{報告|ほうこく}する。
examples.english: The accounting staff close the books each month and report the receipts and payments.

notes:
Note the irregular reading: {出|すい} (not しゅつ). From {出|すい} (out) + {納|とう} (take in).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出納帳|すいとうちょう}: cashbook, account book
- {現金|げんきん}{出納|すいとう}: cash receipts and payments
- {出納|すいとう}{係|がかり}: cashier; teller

NOTE: A fairly formal, accounting-specific term; in everyday speech one would simply say お{金|かね}の{管理|かんり} (managing money).
